## Subscriber

The party on the receiving end of subscriptions: who holds them, since when, and which ones. The Subscription card owns each plan's own life (price, billing cycle, status); this card is the holder-side grouping that renewals, upgrade prompts and "your plans" pages address.

- `holder`: linksTo Contact
- `since`: DateField
- `subscriptions`: linksToMany Subscription, a small set kept by whatever starts or stops one
- `activeCount`: computed from the linked subscriptions' status

```ts
import { Subscriber } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/commerce/subscriber';

class SeasonTicketHolder extends Subscriber {
  /* seat, stand */
}
```

### Example

Acme Industries, through Farah Zulkifli, holding Workspace Pro and the data add-on.

### Non-goals

Billing and plan lifecycle stay on Subscription; payment method and invoicing are their own blocks. A subscriber isn't a Loyalty Account: holding a plan and building standing are different relationships, so an app that wants both links both to the same Contact.
